name: Sakai Yuriko
source:
School nurse at Seika Girls' Academy.
Because of her gentle demeanor and caring nature, she is trusted by the students.
She manages all of their physical data.
In reality, she is well-versed in the inner workings of the school and works behind the scenes as a staff member playing the role of "candy." She also secretly and openly supports the [url=/c102364]protagonist[/url], who is her childhood friend. 

[From [url=https://dl.getchu.com/i/item1003642]DL.Getchu.com[/url]]
